title: config/knip-entries.json
description: The entry files of knip that the repository adds to the layout entries of knip.json, the copy of kit: the files that make runs outside those patterns, each with its reason. make lint-ts runs knip with knip.json and these entries (scripts/kit/lint-ts.mts).

entries.description: Each entry glob, relative to the root, with the reason that it is an entry, such as the make target that runs it.
